title: 2013 HMMT February Guts Problem 13
statement: Find the smallest positive integer \(n\) such that \(\frac{5^{n+1}+2^{n+1}}{5^{n}+2^{n}}>4.99\).

solutions.text: 7 Writing \(5^{n+1}=5 \cdot 5^{n}\) and \(2^{n+1}=2 \cdot 2^{n}\) and cross-multiplying yields \(0.01 \cdot 5^{n}>2.99 \cdot 2^{n}\), and re-arranging yields \((2.5)^{n}>299\). A straightforward calculation shows that the smallest \(n\) for which this is true is \(n=7\).
